achv_consumer.name: 有錢人
achv_consumer.desc: 商店與旅館累計消費 1,000 金幣
achv_consumer.desc_en: Spend a total of 1,000 gold at shops and inns

achv_vip.name: 尊爵不凡 VIP
achv_vip.desc: 商店與旅館累計消費 10,000 金幣

achv_tower_climber.name: 登塔者

achv_tower_master.name: 塔頂之影
achv_tower_master.desc_en: Climb to floor 40 of the Magic Tower

achv_boss_hunter.name: 獵首者

achv_boss_dominator.name: 區域制霸

achv_boss_sargeras.name: 討伐魔王
